title: Star Field
description: The classic fly-through: stars stream out of a vanishing point toward you, near ones sweeping past far faster than distant ones. Turn up Warp and the points stretch into hyperspace streaks while the whole field accelerates — push it and it tips into a full jump, with a motion-blur smear for extra speed. A slow Twist barrel-rolls the field, three colour modes (white, temperature-by-depth, rainbow) recolour it, and the pointer steers where the stars emerge from. Star count, speed, warp, spread, twist and glow are live params; beats fire a warp burst.
